snippet.title: Fallout 76: The Slasher Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Available now for all Fallout 76 players, The Slasher Update features an all-new series of eerie & exciting emergency broadcasts airing in parts over multiple weeks. These broadcasts lead players to unravel the mystery behind these macabre masked murders, with tasks ranging from fighting Infestations of fanatical Slasher supporters to digging up unmarked graves for clues. 

As more broadcasts air and more tasks are completed, the more likely you'll attract The Slasher's personal attention. Corner the villain behind the grisly spree (or survive being cornered) for the chance at a unique Power Armor set, a new super-sharp Super Slasher weapon, a chance to rest easy that night (though a real Slasher never stays dead forever, right?) and much, much more! 

Follow us on the following sites and social media:

ESRB RATING: Mature with Blood and Gore, Drug Reference, Intense Violence, Strong Language, Suggestive Themes, and Use of Alcohol.
